On Windows, the widget may disappear when you press **Win+D**. Open **Settings** from the tray if you need to manage your countdowns. Countdowner reads your existing countdowns and settings from `%APPDATA%\Countdowner\config.json`.

- Rebuild the desktop app in Rust with Native Shell 0.7.2. The Windows build uses Win32, Direct2D and DirectWrite. The source also supports native macOS and Linux builds.
- Use regional Noto Sans CJK subsets for interface text so labels and countdowns have more consistent weights across all five languages. Windows uses the regional system font for custom titles in Chinese, Japanese and Korean interfaces.

Download the Windows x64 or ARM64 ZIP, extract it, and run `Countdowner.exe`. Keep the `licenses/` directory. The executable is portable and unsigned.
